brief.zh: 找出数字文本、缺测值和重复记录，决定哪些读数进入分析。
brief.en: Find text values, missing readings, and duplicate records. Decide what should reach the analysis.

concept.zh: 转换数据类型，按清晰的规则处理缺测与重复。
concept.en: Convert data types and apply clear rules for missing and duplicate values.

body.zh: 平板输入的 ‘ 21 ’ 带有空格，仍能转成数字 21。pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce') 会把转不了的值记成缺失，方便下一步处理。
body.en: A value typed as ' 21 ' has spaces and can still become the number 21. pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce') marks values it cannot convert as missing.

body.zh: 本课把同一个记录编号当成一次测量，用 drop_duplicates 找出重复记录。不同编号碰巧测到同一个温度时，两次测量都保留。
body.en: In this course, a record ID identifies one measurement. Use drop_duplicates to remove repeated records. Different IDs can have the same temperature and both measurements count.

body.zh: 做真实分析时，先检查记录怎样缺失，再决定处理办法。这个练习会剔除无法转换的温度，从原表和结果表就能发现哪些行被剔除了。
body.en: In a real analysis, investigate why values are missing before choosing a treatment. Here, we remove readings that cannot be converted and compare the two tables to see what was removed.

caption.zh: 读到四行原始记录。编号 41 出现了两次。
caption.en: Four raw rows come in. Record 41 appears twice.

caption.zh: 把能读懂的值转成数字，把离线的读数记为缺失。
caption.en: Convert the readable values to numbers and mark the offline reading as missing.

caption.zh: 剔除缺测值，合并重复编号。编号 41 和 43 都进入分析。
caption.en: Drop the missing reading and merge duplicate IDs. Both 41 and 43 enter the analysis.

prompt.zh: 清洗后为什么仍有两个温度为 21 的读数？
prompt.en: Why are there still two readings of 21 after cleaning?

options.zh: 它们是编号不同的两次测量
options.en: They are two measurements with different IDs
They have not been converted to numbers

options.zh: 去重规则只处理小于 21 的值
options.en: The deduplication rule only applies to values below 21

feedback.zh: 记录编号说明测量的身份。每次测量都有自己的编号，同温可以出现多次。
feedback.en: The record ID identifies the measurement. Different measurements can report the same temperature.
